fields.v: Partly (0.5): body reports negative and mixed results openly (free retrieval hurts, summary reuse does not reduce cost on Lite, p. 8), but abstract and introduction claim 'significantly' improved accuracy and reduced token cost without statistical tests
fields.quote: Thus, in this setup, summary-based reuse does not reduce cost relative to the baseline, and autonomous retrieval tends to increase repository access and overall token consumption.
fields.why: The paper states its negative and mixed results explicitly in the body, so only the abstract overclaims; Partly fits the scale better than No.
fields.doubt: Os autores admitem no texto (pág. 8) que os resumos não baixam o custo e que a recuperação livre piora; o exagero está só no resumo ('significantly'). Decide se Q9 é Não (0) ou Parcial (0.5).
